title: SR-OS Pulse Protocol
description: Schema definitions for Super Reality OS mesh pulse protocol

PulseStart.title: Pulse Start Payload
PulseStart.description: Initiates a pulse across the SR-OS mesh

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this pulse run

targets.description: List of agent nodes that should acknowledge this pulse

requested_by.description: Email address of the operator initiating the pulse

log_mode.description: Whether to enable detailed logging for this pulse

description.description: Human-readable description of the pulse purpose

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the pulse was initiated

simulate_timeout.description: Flag to request a timeout simulation from the agent

AckResponse.title: ACK Response
AckResponse.description: Acknowledgment response from a mesh agent

agent.description: Agent identifier responding to the pulse

run_id.description: Must exactly match the run_id from the pulse.start payload

ack_timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the ACK was generated

notes.description: Brief message about the ACK status (max 280 characters)
